stories.title: Why Philly? Why not Cleveland or Miami? Here's eve...
stories.summary: LeBron James' decision creates massive questions for Philly, Cleveland, Miami and the legend who once again just rocked the NBA.

stories.title: Kraft: Pats offer Gonzalez richest CB deal ever
stories.summary: Patriots owner Robert Kraft says the team has made an offer to CB Christian Gonzalez that would "make him the highest-paid player to ever play that position in the NFL."

stories.title: LeBron chooses 76ers, calls it his 'last decision'...
stories.summary: LeBron James, after considering retirement, is continuing his NBA career with the 76ers. James is taking a two-year, $8 million deal, Klutch Sports Group CEO Rich Paul told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Packers CEO questions team's financial viability
stories.summary: Packers president and CEO Ed Policy says adjustments might be necessary as the NFL's only publicly owned franchise attempts to remain financially competitive in the long term.

stories.title: Richardson, Lyles win 100m at U.S. championships
stories.summary: Sha'Carri Richardson and Noah Lyles surged to 100-meter wins at the U.S. track and field championships.
